Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Suppose someone else took control of my Storage Annex (Disputed Territory, ..). Suppose the card on it isn't exchanged and that its new controller is ousted.
Storage Annex is removed from the game. The card on it is burned.
Does it go to my ash heap, or is it removed from the game?

Thanks

~~

Storage Annex
Cardtype:	Master
Master: location.
Put a card from your hand face down (out of play) on this card when you play it. You may look at the card at any time. During your master phase, you may exchange a card in your hand for the card on this Storage Annex.

Messages.Author: jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
When a Methuselah is ousted, all cards he controls are removed from game.
A card inside a Storage Annex is not controlled by anybody.
Therefore, it would go to the ash heap.

Q.E.D.

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body: By "the" ash heap, do you mean "my" ash heap (I own that card), or the ash heap of the person being ousted (as she controlled the Storage Annex) (which would immediately remove it from the game) ?

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
> [url=http://white-wolf.com/vtes/?line=rulings wrote:
> Rulings[/url]]Cards that go into an ash heap, hand, or library always go into their owner's ash heap, hand, or library. RTR 19970425

Messages.Body:
